Granted patent in the jurisdiction.provides: enforceable rights, a presumption of validity

Pending application only.requires: a filing made and examination incomplete
Pending application only.provides: no enforceable right yet, protection only on later grant

Patent expired or lapsed.requires: the term ended or renewal missed
Patent expired or lapsed.provides: no exclusivity remaining, the disclosure free for anyone to use

Patent already revoked on prior art.provides: no rights at all, the invention in the public domain

Literal copying of a claim.requires: a product falling squarely within the wording
Literal copying of a claim.provides: a straightforward comparison, little construction needed

Equivalents argument.requires: a variant outside the literal wording
Equivalents argument.provides: dependence on the doctrine applied, an uncertain outcome

Contributory supply of a component.requires: a part with no other substantial use
Contributory supply of a component.provides: liability without making the whole, dependence on the supplier's knowledge

Independent development.requires: a defendant who never saw the patent
Independent development.provides: no copying to prove, intent irrelevant to infringement

Invalidity counterclaim.provides: an attack on the patent itself, a risk of losing the patent entirely

Non-infringement on construction.provides: no challenge to validity, a narrow escape on wording

Licence already held.requires: an existing agreement covering the acts
Licence already held.provides: a complete defence, no need to litigate the merits

Settlement and cross-licence.requires: a portfolio of value to the other side
Settlement and cross-licence.provides: a business resolution, no judgment on the merits

Injunction granted.requires: infringement of a valid claim found
Injunction granted.provides: the product off the market, damages to follow

Patent revoked in the proceedings.provides: no rights left to enforce, costs against the patentee

Claim dismissed for non-infringement.requires: the product held outside the claims
Claim dismissed for non-infringement.provides: the patent surviving, the defendant free
